name: Knights of the Round Table
summary: These are the knights of Camelot. It seems like the table remembers more than their oaths ...
legend: Long before the stone remembered its name, a round table stood in the halls of Camelot, and no seat at it was higher than another. King Arthur sat there beneath a golden crown, his royal blue mantle marked with a cross of gold, his blue eyes fixed on a kingdom he had sworn to hold together. At his side stood Sir Lancelot in steel and crimson, a white cross across his chest and a secret hidden behind his quiet smile. And at the far end, in white robes and gold, sat young Sir Galahad, the only knight whose green eyes never seemed to look away from something no one else could see. The candles burned low. Then one seat at the table, empty for a hundred years, began to whisper a name...

skins.name: King Arthur
skins.story: The crowned king in royal blue and gold, whose blue eyes hold Camelot together with nothing but an oath and a cross of gold.

skins.name: Sir Lancelot
skins.story: The greatest blade of Camelot, clad in grey steel and crimson with a white cross, who smiles like a man keeping a secret.

skins.name: Sir Galahad
skins.story: The youngest knight, robed in white and gold with a red cross, whose green eyes seem to watch something only he can see.

versions.note: The Round Table is called to order: King Arthur, Sir Lancelot and Sir Galahad take their seats in Camelot. One chair still waits, empty.

versions.title: The Grail Quest

skins.name: Sir Percival
skins.story: Raised in the Welsh woods far from any court, he rode to Camelot with a hunting spear and became one of the three knights to see the Holy Grail.

skins.name: Sir Bors
skins.story: Steadfast Sir Bors bears a red bend on ermine, and of the three Grail knights he alone came home to Camelot to tell the tale.

skins.name: The Fisher King
skins.story: Wounded and unable to ride, the old king of the Grail castle passes his days fishing on the river, waiting for the knight who will ask the right question.

versions.note: Galahad does not ride alone: Sir Percival from the Welsh woods, steadfast Sir Bors and the wounded Fisher King who keeps the Grail castle join the quest for the Holy Grail.

versions.title: The Enchanters of Avalon

skins.name: Merlin
skins.story: The old enchanter who foresaw the Round Table long before it was built, his beard white as frost and his robe dark as the night sky he reads.

skins.name: Morgan le Fay
skins.story: Arthur's half-sister and Merlin's best pupil, the enchantress of Avalon wears a golden crescent and a gown as green as the isle she rules.

skins.name: The Lady of the Lake
skins.story: From beneath the still water of the lake she raised the sword Excalibur for the young king, and one day she will take it back.

versions.note: Magic comes to Camelot: Merlin the enchanter who raised the boy king, his rival Morgan le Fay, and the Lady of the Lake who gave Arthur the sword Excalibur.

versions.title: The New Year Feast

skins.name: Sir Gawain
skins.story: The king's nephew answered the Green Knight's challenge, and he still wears the gold pentangle on red and the green girdle he brought back from the Green Chapel.

skins.name: The Green Knight
skins.story: A giant green from beard to boots rode into the New Year feast with a holly bough and a great axe, and offered any knight one free blow.

skins.name: Queen Guinevere
skins.story: The queen of Camelot loves the month of May, and on the first morning of it she rides out with her court crowned in gold and dressed in rose.

versions.note: At the New Year feast a giant all in green rides into the hall of Camelot with a challenge, Sir Gawain rises to answer it, and Queen Guinevere watches from the high table.

Centre: Sir Lancelot with a grey steel cap with a red stripe, brown moustache, red surcoat with a white cross, grey plate armour, red bands on his legs, dark brown boots.
